info.title: FieldLoop internal mock CMMS
info.description: Synthetic read-only simulator endpoint from architecture section 4.2. Not a web-api/BFF endpoint. Run behind Cloud Run invoker IAM in dev/demo; local fixtures need no credentials. No real CMMS connector or publication.

servers.description: Local simulator as the repository README starts it. Deployed environments call the private simulator-{env} Cloud Run service with a Google OIDC ID token.

get.description: Return four deterministic synthetic work orders for DL-01, each naming the Barrier it maintains, or the open preventive ones due at or before asOf when pmDue=true. Each carries the Organisation the simulator is configured for; no source write, database, publisher or remote IO. This bounded internal fixture list is not the paginated public platform list API.

parameters.name: pmDue
parameters.description: Only open preventive work due at or before asOf.

parameters.name: asOf
parameters.description: Timezone-aware Scenario time, not wall time; the response reports it in UTC. The default is the start of the DL-01 simulation, fixed for deterministic replay.

400.description: Invalid query; code validation_failed, input values are not echoed.

405.description: Only GET is allowed; code method_not_allowed. No state mutation.

serviceIdentity.description: Verified by Cloud Run invoker IAM, not proxy headers. The handler does not implement browser auth or independently validate IAM.
